hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask", "permissionDecisionReason": "DevOps deployment workflow: this Cloudflare API call (execute or deploy) can change live resources."}}'

in=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null) || cmd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("command") or "")' 2>/dev/null) || cmd=$in; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])wrangler([[:space:]"]|$)'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask", "permissionDecisionReason": "DevOps deployment workflow: wrangler can deploy to the live Cloudflare environment."}}'; fi
